route_only_change: s2Size != 0 && sparseBlockSize <= 4 && sparseBlockSize != 1 selects V; all other cases select C
source_version: Installed source identified by per-file SHA256; no assumed local Git HEAD.

source_anchors.fact: Only block size 1 changes template. Sizes 2 and 4 retain V, sizes >=8 retain C.
S2 outer tile 512 is computed independently of sparse block size.
Each sparse index expands to [id*size,min(id*size+size,threshold)); size 1 is the identical token. Future entries skip and -1 terminates.
The pipeline can read one index before checking its validCount boundary; fixture uses numel+1 guarded backing without changing shape.
The copy walker advances by actual blockLen and preserves arbitrary selected-index ordering.
DataCopyPA allows actual copyRowCnt=1 and writes each NZ row at a 32-byte aligned offset.
C MM1 writes selected K and RoPE directly into L1; 128-row tile is independent from sparse block length.
C MM2 uses the same walker for V with 128-row L0 slices and actual tail lengths.
Documented nValue range is 0..16384 and destination alignment is 32 bytes; no minimum of 4 or 8.

selection: Original [8,1,2048] arbitrary token tensor retained identically in every arm; no token expansion, coarsening, or conversion kernel.
boundary: Source does not prove performance or full-model registration compatibility. Single-op SFA-only host overlay remains experimental.
